card.name: MBq in radioactivity dose amounts
card.fires_on: The final letter q of MBq (megabecquerel) right after a number in radiopharmaceutical dose statements, such as 111 MBq to 185 MBq. Weaker on dose units like mg or daily in dose ranges.

modes.label: MBq after a number
modes.description: The q ending MBq in recommended radioactivity ranges for imaging agents.

modes.description: Units or frequency words after a dose number in a range or schedule.
modes.example: Indomethacin immediate-release capsules 75 mg to 150 mg<< daily>> in 3 or 4 divided doses

card.writes: It seems to push toward quantity words like "at least", "up to" and "more than", while suppressing unrelated word pieces.
card.plain: It lights up on the unit MBq in radioactive imaging-agent doses, just before the second number in a range or a mCi value.
